fields: h, intro, items [{t, d, spot | icon, shape}], spot (base glyph), base, fold, fold_noun. shape: "tag" (default), "round" or "folder"; folders sit on the navy strip (desktop).
best_for: OptionTags lays a system's configuration options out as physical tags on a limestone table, so each option reads as a separate item the buyer can add to the base skid.

items.d: Strips carbon dioxide ahead of EDI without dosing caustic, where feed alkalinity is high.
Two trains at [duplex train shares offered] each: one runs while the other is sanitized.
Circulates when storage is full, so water never stands in the membranes.
After DI or EDI, where your microbial target needs more margin. Ultraviolet (UV) lowers the viable count; it does not sanitize.
A concentrate recovery RO stage cuts water to drain where sewer charges or supply limits matter.
